picks.name: Qorvo

picks.name: ACM Research

catalysts.name: Micron Technology, Inc.
catalysts.what: Fiscal Q4 revenue $54.2B beat the $51.1B estimate (data-center revenue up sharply on AI memory demand) and adjusted EPS $33.42 vs $31.61 expected; guided FY27 above Street, expecting sequential revenue growth each quarter. Reaction was muted (roughly +0.2% to +0.4% after-hours) — noted here, not oversold.

catalysts.name: Target Corporation
catalysts.what: HSBC upgraded to Buy from Hold and raised its price target to $190 from $125 (about +21% above the current price), citing a traffic-driven same-store-sales recovery (+3.8%). Shares rose roughly +2% on the day.

catalysts.name: Synopsys, Inc.
catalysts.what: Signed a multi-year, $1B+ agreement making Amazon the lead customer for Synopsys' new application-optimized silicon IP business, spanning EDA software, simulation tools and agentic-AI engineering workflows. Shares jumped about +4.8% intraday.

catalysts.name: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Company
catalysts.what: Won a $1.2B order from cloud provider Vultr for AMD Helios AI racks (72 MI455X GPUs per rack) — HPE's first Helios win — alongside a raised FY27 outlook for its Networking segment. Shares rose about +3.9%.
